gaps.lead: Their wedding will take place in June.
gaps.explanation: Weddings/concerts are held: will be held (in June).

gaps.lead: He finally managed to solve the puzzle.
gaps.explanation: manage to do = be able to do.

gaps.lead: 'I'm sorry I was rude to your sister,' Maria said.
gaps.sentence: Maria apologised ___ rude to my sister.
gaps.explanation: apologise for + -ing (or having + participle for the earlier action).

gaps.lead: He started playing golf at the age of six.
gaps.sentence: He ___ golf at the age of six.
gaps.explanation: take up = start (a hobby/sport): took up golf.

gaps.lead: I got used to night shifts after a month.
gaps.sentence: After a month, I ___ night shifts.
gaps.explanation: After a period: be used to (state) or had got used to (achievement).

gaps.lead: Despite his injury, he finished the marathon.
gaps.explanation: in spite of + noun/-ing: In spite of his injury.
